text:
mira: FYI I hit a crash in the Next sample when deployed as an Edge function (Vercel). Error on first LLM call: "TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'createClient')". Dev server (node) is fine.

sam: rough. Can you share repro steps?

mira: minimal: checkout sample-apps/next, pnpm install, pnpm build, vercel deploy --prod (edge runtime). Crash only in the production edge build.

jordan: any idea which import failed? bundlers sometimes tree-shake side-effectful modules.

mira: dug in: our SDK package.json currently has:
```json
{"name":"@redwood/inference-js","version":"0.9.1","main":"dist/index.cjs.js","module":"dist/index.mjs","types":"dist/index.d.ts","sideEffects":false,"exports":{".":{"import":"./dist/index.mjs","require":"./dist/index.cjs.js"}}}
```

sam: sideEffects:false stands out. If we rely on a top-level file that registers a global adapter (kv cache shim), bundlers can drop it. Does index.mjs re-export a shim?

mira: yes, index.mjs does `export * from './kv-cache-shim.js'` and kv-cache-shim registers a global. In prod optimization the shim gets removed so createClient ends up undefined.

jordan: Vite/esbuild/webpack can all behave differently depending on the build mode. In dev the shim was kept, so tests passed. In optimized edge build it was pruned.

alex: quick local test: forcing `import '@redwood/inference-js/dist/kv-cache-shim.js'` in app entry fixes the crash in the edge build. Confirms shim removal.

mira: we need a packaging fix so downstream apps don't have to know the workaround. Options:
- mark that file as side-effectful: `"sideEffects": ["dist/kv-cache-shim.js"]`
- make shim an explicit export: `"./shim": "./dist/kv-cache-shim.js"` and encourage import
- move the registration behind an explicit `init()` that users call (breaking change)

sam: pragmatically, adding the sideEffects array + shim export is lowest friction. Also consider changing index.mjs from pure re-export to an explicit import for the shim: `import './kv-cache-shim.js'; export * from './client.js';` but note that may still be dropped unless sideEffects permits it.

jordan: agreed. Proposed tasks:
1) SDK repo: add `"sideEffects": ["dist/kv-cache-shim.js"]` and an explicit `"./shim"` export. mira to open PR.
2) CI: add a smoke step that does a production build of sample-apps/next and runs one endpoint against a local edge emulator. alex to add.
3) Docs: add a short note in devex about common bundler traps for libraries targeting edge runtimes (Vite/webpack/esbuild) with examples. sam to draft.

mira: I'll open the PR. Also noticed a related TS import mismatch: some consumers do `import Redwood from '@redwood/inference-js'` and rely on default import. Our ESM build only uses named exports which can confuse certain bundlers/tsconfig combos. We'll add compatibility typings.

alex: add a small snippet for the docs: recommended package.json for edge libs: include module + main + types + sideEffects array + explicit exports.

ci-bot: Created PR #274 by mira: fix(sdk): mark kv shim as side-effectful and add shim export

sam: sweet. can we also add a release checklist item: run sample-apps/next production build and verify on edge emulator? last time something slipped that only failed on Cloudflare.

jordan: adding checklist item to RELEASE_CHECKLIST.md in infra repo.

mira: PR link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/274 — includes package.json change and a small smoke test. Please review. :rocket:
